inputs.original_text: This isn’t a genuine political transition—it looks like a takeover designed to make local people too poor to hold on to what still works. Once they’re pushed out of the way, wealthy diaspora and foreign investors can scoop up property and businesses cheaply. The real question is who’s steering this process and arranging things so they profit while residents lose out. I don’t believe that outcome is accidental.
inputs.modified_text: This looks less like a political transition and more like a coordinated takeover: squeeze local people until they can no longer hold on to their property or businesses, then let wealthy diaspora and foreign investors buy up what’s left cheaply. The key question is who is steering it and setting up the conditions for them to profit. I don’t buy that residents losing out is some accidental side effect.
